summary:
Google Search is the homepage people mean when they look up a Google favicon. Gmail, Maps, Drive and Gemini ship different icons and are not substituted here. This page keeps only what google.com itself returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against google.com. HTML came from https://www.google.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/searchlogo/ico/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.google.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 5430 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #3388ff comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-32x32-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-32x32-01.png at 32×32 (png, 1322 bytes) from https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/searchlogo/ico/favicon.ico.
